Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the match. It stores the player's profile details (nickname and color), their current in-game resources (prestige points and food), their personal Tribe layout, and tracking values for available card picks.

  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      public Player(Color color, String nickname)
      Constructs a new Player instance with a specified color and nickname. Initial resources (prestige and food) and card picks are set to 0, and a blank personal Tribe is assigned.
      Parameters:
      color - the color assigned to the player
      nickname - the unique identification name of the player
